source_version: Capella (continuously deployed, no discrete version number)

notable_absence.finding: This page is an A-Z index of SQL++ reserved keywords, most of which are individually hyperlinked to the statement/clause/operator page that defines them (e.g. [GRANT](grant.md), [ROLLBACK](rollback-transaction.md), [SAVEPOINT](savepoint.md)). Treating every one of these ~90 index links as a distinct seeAlso relation would just re-derive the site's table of contents rather than assert anything new about the linked concepts, and the page has no Purpose/Prerequisites/access-control content of its own - so this extraction is left empty rather than mechanically emitting a large batch of low-information seeAlso edges. One point of interest not modeled as a relation: the page calls out that 'AI' is deliberately NOT a reserved word despite being used in the USING AI statement ('The word AI is not a reserved word, even though you can use it in combination with the USING keyword as part of the USING AI statement.') - a minor grammar carve-out for an AI-related feature, noted here in case USING AI is covered by another batch.
